Class DecisionFigureTornado

java.lang.Object
network.ike.docs.koncept.DecisionFigureTornado
public final class DecisionFigureTornado extends Object
A tornado diagram of a decision tree's one-way sensitivity as a DecisionFigure, drawn as the live TornadoChart draws it: one bar per swept measure, longest first, on one axis, which is the expected cost at the root, with a dashed line at the base case. A bar spans the root's cost from the measure's lower end to its upper end; it is solid when the block stated that range and hollow when the sweep assumed it. Where the root's chosen alternative flips inside the range, the bar changes colour beyond the flip and a tick carries the threshold. The builder reads a DecisionFigureTornado.Tornado, which is the sweep as numbers and names, so a sweep over the stored tree and a sweep over a block's text draw the same bars.

Kept word for word in step with its twin in komet-claude-plugin, package network.ike.komet.claude.decision.render.
